Solution

Compliance Operations

Compliance operations are where regulatory expectations become daily work: controls to operate, evidence to collect, policies to maintain and issues to close. When this work runs on spreadsheets and inbox chasers, control effectiveness is hard to demonstrate. We redesign compliance operations so that managing risk is a property of the process itself.

Capabilities

Managing risk through better operational process

Controls

Control inventories linked to obligations, with clear design, owners, frequency and testing requirements that operate in the workflow rather than alongside it.

Regulatory evidence

Evidence requested, collected, reviewed and retained against each control, so that examination requests are answered from the record.

Governance

Committee calendars, decision logs, action tracking and escalation paths that show how oversight actually operates.

Audit readiness

Continuous evidence capture and pre-audit reviews, so preparation is a steady state rather than a scramble before each visit.

Policy management

Policy lifecycle workflows covering drafting, approval, attestation, review cycles and the link from each policy to the controls it requires.

Compliance operations

Monitoring, issue management and remediation workflows, with root cause captured and recurring issues surfaced to the right forum.

Assurance workflows

Second-line and independent testing workflows with sampling logic, test documentation and finding ownership through to closure.

Control lifecycle

Evidence is a by-product of operating the control

The loop runs continuously. Each pass produces the evidence for the next assurance cycle, so the regulator-ready record is a by-product of normal operation.

Typical challenges

Why compliance operations struggle to show control

  • Control libraries that drift from actual practice because nobody owns the link between them
  • Evidence held by individuals, making continuity dependent on who is available
  • Issues tracked in multiple trackers, with ageing and root cause invisible to committees
  • Policy attestation run as an annual email exercise with low completion assurance

Expected outcomes

What good looks like

A control inventory that second line can test and first line can operate without interpretation

Evidence requests answered from a single record, with reduced preparation time before reviews

Issue ageing and root cause visible to governance forums in a consistent format

Attestation completion tracked with escalation for overdue responses

Questions

Compliance operations: common questions

Do you provide compliance advice?

We design operations and controls to support your compliance framework. Regulatory interpretation and legal advice remain the responsibility of your compliance, legal and risk functions. We work to the obligations you define.

Can you work with our GRC platform?

Yes. Where a GRC platform is your system of record, we design the operational workflows around it and integrate evidence and issue data without duplicating the record. Where no platform exists, we build the operational layer on a controlled workflow platform.

How do you approach audit readiness?

We move evidence capture into the process so it is collected at the point of control operation. Readiness reviews then check completeness and quality against the examination scope, rather than attempting to reconstruct history.

Find out how ready your controls really are.

A readiness review tests evidence quality against the examination scope you are most likely to face.
